assessmentPolicy.acceptance: Require method gains beyond max(2%, retained spread) in both passes, no repeated control timing regression beyond that bound, and no repeated complete-job allocation growth above 0.5%.
assessmentPolicy.rationale: Reuse the current operation first live class-MRO result across the side-effect-free own-attribute dictionary lookup in sync and awaited readers. Preserve data descriptor precedence, live slot/member mutations, exact receiver/context/span, fees/checkpoints, shadowing, engine fallback and actual suspension/reentry. No persistent guest-value cache, compiler/frame/namespace change or reduced fees.
assessmentPolicy.controls: Empty, integer loop, positional/keyword calls, full stable sort/output and ASCII pipeline; preserve all seven canonical cases.
assessmentPolicy.semanticGates: Eighteen independently pinned original MRO/descriptor/context/funding/checkpoint/real-host checks and four CPython public goldens, existing default-slot and call tests, full matching Debug/VM Release suites per producer before timing.
assessmentPolicy.nativeCode: Keep every native body/tier, inline summary and call/jump transfer for instance readers, MRO lookup, binding, frame entry, execution and guards. No size-speed forecast.
assessmentPolicy.genuineAsync: Actual awaited descriptor/host suspension and cancellation preserve the current receiver/context/span and later fresh class lookup.
